title: Space left
statement:
Give how much of the limit is left.

`used` and `limit` are numbers stored as strings. Give `limit` minus `used` as one number. Use `tonumber` on both.

title: User label
statement:
Build a label for the user.

`id` is a number. Give the string `user-` followed by the id, for example `user-42`. Join the two with `+`. Use `tostring` on the id first.

title: Version string
statement:
Build the version string from its numbers.

The numbers are in the `parts` array. Turn every number into a string. Then glue them with a `.` between them, for example `1.4.2`. Use `map(tostring)`, then `join`.
